problem.complexity: O(log n) time and O(1) space.
problem.explanation: In a rotated sorted array, one half is always sorted. Check which half is sorted, then see if the target falls within the sorted half's range. If it does, search that half. Otherwise, search the other half.
hints: At least one half of the array will always be sorted.

problem.statement_markdown: There is an integer array `nums` sorted in ascending order (with distinct values). Prior to being passed to your function, `nums` is possibly rotated at an unknown pivot index. Given the array `nums` after the possible rotation and an integer `target`, return the index of `target` if it is in `nums`, or `-1` if it is not in `nums`.
problem.title: Search in rotated sorted array
